summary.title: Moebius: 0.2B Lightweight Image Inpainting Framework with 10B-Level Performance

setting_and_object.category: Architecture (lightweight diffusion backbone) plus paired distillation strategy

details: 10B-level inpainting foundation models (FLUX.1-Fill-Dev, SD3.5-Large-Inpainting) are too costly to deploy, but naive substitution of lightweight operators (DWConv, linear attention) into a diffusion inpainting backbone causes a severe representation bottleneck; also, gated linear attention has no cross-attention formulation for injecting external semantic priors.

Moebius: a 0.22B latent-diffusion inpainting U-Net built from the Local-lambda Mix Interaction (LlambdaMI) block, whose Local-lambda and Interactive-lambda modules replace self- and cross-attention by summarizing spatial context and the global semantic prior into fixed-size linear 'lambda' matrices (content mapping softmax(K)^T V plus a positional mapping) that queries multiply, combined with DWConv residual blocks and Mix-FFN.

Paired adaptive multi-granularity knowledge distillation performed entirely in latent space (coarse bottleneck feature + fine output + latent perceptual losses), with loss weights set dynamically from ratios of gradient norms rather than fixed hyperparameters.
Latent diffusion (SDXL VAE) with Latent Categories Guidance (LCG) embeddings as global prior, 512x512 input resolution.
Teacher: officially pretrained PixelHacker (0.862B), an LCG-based SOTA inpainting diffusion model.
Local-lambda perception window r = 15; E-LatentLPIPS used as latent perceptual loss; CFG scale 2.5 (natural) / 2.0 (portrait), 20 sampling steps.
Distillation: 16 NVIDIA L40S GPUs, batch size 768, 138K iterations, BF16, Muon optimizer, weight decay 0.1, LR 2e-4 decayed 0.1x at 111K/129K.
Per-benchmark fine-tuning: Places2 (1.8M imgs, 51K iters), CelebA-HQ (24K imgs, 60K iters), FFHQ (60K imgs, 117K iters).

Places2 in four protocols (Test 10K following PowerPaint; Large/Small masks following MAT; 256 free-form following MI-GAN); CelebA-HQ (512, large masks); FFHQ (256, LaMa-style masks); metrics FID and LPIPS.
Efficiency profiled uniformly: single L40S, batch 1, 512x512, ms/step, TFLOPs, plus total inference time accounting for default step counts (20 vs 28/50).

OOD zero-shot evaluation on 10K LVIS images and 3K DeepFakeFace wiki portraits; double-blind user study with 22 participants, 50 cases per scenario (natural/portrait/real-world removal); real-world object removal qualitatives and comparison to commercial editors (Nano Banana, Qwen Image Edit).
Academic diffusion: PixelHacker (teacher), PowerPaint, HD-Painter, DDNM, RoRem, LDM/SD.
Non-diffusion: MAT, LaMa, MI-GAN, CoModGAN, MADF, AOT-GAN, DeepFillv2, EdgeConnect, Latent-C.I.

15-configuration architecture study on Places2 (Test) at an 18K-iteration checkpoint, swapping GLA/standard cross-attention/FFN/Conv for Local-lambda, Interactive-lambda, Mix-FFN, DWConv, each with and without distillation.
Incremental dissection of the four distillation losses; CFG scale sweeps; teacher-student activation map comparison across granularities.

key_findings.finding: A 0.22B task-specific specialist can match or beat 10B-level industrial inpainting generalists while being drastically cheaper.
key_findings.evidence: Moebius reaches FID 0.92 / LPIPS 0.091 on Places2 (Small) versus FLUX.1-Fill-Dev's 0.94 / 0.099, and 5.39 / 0.122 on CelebA-HQ and 8.15 / 0.231 on FFHQ versus FLUX's 10.13 / 0.141 and 11.19 / 0.268, using 0.226B vs 11.902B parameters, 0.154 vs 9.927 TFLOPs, 26.01 vs 161.01 ms/step, and 0.52 s vs 8.05 s total inference (>15x).

key_findings.finding: Naive drop-in of lightweight operators collapses inpainting quality, whereas the holistic LlambdaMI combination compresses without collapse.
key_findings.evidence: In the 18K-checkpoint study, single substitutions degrade the 526M baseline (FID 32.75) to 35.24-43.58 (DWConv worst at 43.58); replacing both attentions with Local-lambda + Interactive-lambda together gives FID 33.21 at 485M with improved LPIPS 0.286 vs 0.298.

key_findings.finding: The adaptive multi-granularity latent distillation is what recovers the capacity lost to extreme compression, and it synergizes specifically with the LlambdaMI design.
key_findings.evidence: The final 226M architecture yields FID 33.42 with standard prediction loss but 26.43 with distillation; the 485M lambda variant improves 33.21 -> 24.73, while distilled isolated-operator variants stay at 26.46-29.41 FID with 315-526M parameters, i.e. off the efficiency front.

key_findings.finding: All four distillation objectives contribute incrementally, with fine-grained and latent perceptual terms being critical.
key_findings.evidence: Coarse-only distillation gives FID 74.20 / LPIPS 0.367; adding fine-grained KD gives 36.17 / 0.291, adding task loss 32.59 / 0.273, and adding E-LatentLPIPS 26.43 / 0.258.

key_findings.finding: Human raters and OOD tests confirm the compact specialist's parity with its teacher and superiority over massive generalists, especially on portraits.
key_findings.evidence: In the double-blind study Moebius averaged 31.76% preference vs PixelHacker 32.18%, FLUX 23.70%, SD3.5 12.36%, peaking at 32.27% on portraits; zero-shot OOD gives FID 17.81 (LVIS) and 15.32 (DeepFakeFace) versus FLUX 14.52 / 12.24 and SD3.5 114.21 / 81.91.
